capabilities: Blur and fade content above and below a fixed clear reading band
Adjust band position, height, transition lengths, blur strength and edge fade
Toggle the effect via ribbon icon, command palette or settings
Temporarily reveal the original text with a hold button
Maintain separate settings profiles for mobile and desktop
disambiguation: Not a zen-style writing focus mode; it is a scrolling reading aid that blurs and fades text outside a fixed clear band.
extras: The interface is currently in Simplified Chinese. Intermittent flicker while scrolling is reported and not conclusively resolved. The README explicitly warns the effect is a visual aid only and not a secure redaction, and describes unverified areas (real-device touch behavior, Windows/Linux, pop-out windows, other themes). Mobile support was added in 1.1.0 and the release is described as ready for mobile trial rather than fully verified.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually narrow a long note to a fixed clear reading area that stays put while the content scrolls underneath.
summary: Reading aid that keeps a fixed clear band on screen while progressively blurring and fading the text above and below it as you scroll.
